A run with a single agent message behaves exactly as today. body.summary: runCodex now returns the LAST codex agent message, so a tool-using run that narrates before answering is parsed correctly by completeStructured, complete and the edit path; the reviewer session reuses it instead of its own copy. The review pipeline's 'a call did not complete' warning now carries the failure detail. New tests: a narrating fake codex (cli-subprocess.test.ts) and the driver warning detail (pipeline-job.test.ts); both fail under their falsifying mutation. Full sweep: 5979 pass, 3 fail, all unrelated (sqlite integer overflow, a git maintenance-lock race in delivery handlers, and review-decision's /private/var path mismatch, which also fails on the pre-fix commit fc08807a).
